claims.text: The dataset consists of 7,787 science exam questions collected from standardized tests across 12 US states over the past decade.
The questions were categorized into a hierarchical taxonomy with 462 fine-grained categories based on a data-driven analysis of exam study guides and training questions.
Two annotators, including a lead annotator with domain expertise, annotated the entire dataset to ensure quality and consistency.
